authorization: Task-book section 5 C2/R5, released by C1 total PASS (analysis/20260916_R4_GATE_01/r4_gate.json) under gpu_platform_decision_20260916.md.

information_interface.architecture: centralized same-tick fusion of four vehicle-local packets and one payload-coordinator packet
information_interface.noise_indexing: per absolute tick, node and field; entropy hashed per tick
information_interface.not_claimed: R5 proves interface transfer only. It does not establish distributed or communication-robust control; impairment injection belongs to E03/E05.

noiseless_no_op_gate.rule: same-backend comparison per gpu_platform_decision_20260916.md rule P2
noiseless_no_op_gate.why_not_the_cpu_baseline: results/20260911_R3_UNFROZEN_FULL01/2ms is retained as the cross-backend equivalence reference (2.4e-05 m over 2200 ticks). Comparing a GPU run against it would measure the already-qualified backend difference instead of the interface, so the no-op gate is applied within one backend and the 1e-12 threshold is unchanged.

stop_rule: N0 failure stops N1. N1 violating a hard gate fails R5; no filter is added and the noise is not reduced to hide it.

launch_defect_record.defect_1: main() created the output directory for pool.json and run() created it again: FileExistsError at tick 0 (first launch attempt).
launch_defect_record.defect_2: run() derived its own model via params('P0') while the CUDA backend was constructed from a different instance. The backend validates identity with `model is not self.source_model`, so linearisation raised CUDA_BACKEND_MODEL_IDENTITY_MISMATCH; solve()'s catch-all turned that into infinite residuals and the JSON writer then raised 'Out of range float values are not JSON compliant' (second launch attempt, 1 tick).
launch_defect_record.defect_3: a failed solve crashed the run instead of being recorded; a non-finite solver record is now written to solver_failure.json and stops the run.
launch_defect_record.disposition: all three fixed on 2026-09-17; verified end to end on a 3-tick segment (3 solver and 3 information records). No R5 result exists from the defective code.
launch_defect_record.precedent: defect_2 and defect_3 are the same classes already hit and fixed in the G3 window runner on 2026-09-15.
